# logcut v0.1.1

This release improves the internal Rust implementation while preserving the existing CLI behavior.

## Changes

- Clarified responsibilities in `main.rs`.
- Reduced and documented unsafe operations.
- Improved error handling around signal and process-group operations.
- Reduced unnecessary copying during log normalization.

## Compatibility

The CLI behavior, output format, environment variables, profiles, and exit codes remain unchanged.
